# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/mise
# args: 
Manage plugins

Usage: mise plugins [FLAGS] [SUBCOMMAND]

Commands:
  install    Install a plugin from a configured source, Git URL, or supported
             archive [aliases: i, a, add]
  link       Link a local plugin directory into mise for development [aliases:
             ln]
  ls         List installed external plugins [aliases: list]
  ls-remote  List all available remote plugins [aliases: list-remote, list-all]
  uninstall  Remove an installed plugin [aliases: remove, rm]
  update     Update a plugin to the latest version [aliases: up, upgrade]
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Flags:
  -c, --core         Only show built-in (core) plugins
                     These are hidden by default
  -u, --urls         Show the git url for each plugin
                     e.g.: https://github.com/mise-plugins/vfox-cmake.git
      --user         List installed plugins

                     This is the default behavior but can be used with --core
                     to show core and user plugins
  -h, --help         Print help

Global flags:
  -C, --cd <DIR>     Change directory before running command
  -E, --env <ENV>    Set the environment for loading `mise.<ENV>.toml`
  -j, --jobs <JOBS>  How many jobs to run in parallel; values below 1 are
                     treated as 1 [default: 8]
                     [env: MISE_JOBS]
  -q, --quiet        Suppress non-error messages
                     [env: MISE_QUIET]
  -v, --verbose      Show extra output (use -vv for even more)
  -y, --yes          Answer yes to all confirmation prompts
      --raw          Read/write directly to stdin/stdout/stderr instead of by
                     line
      --locked       Require lockfile URLs to be present during installation

                     Fails if tools don't have pre-resolved URLs in the lockfile
                     for the current platform.
                     This prevents API calls to GitHub, aqua registry, etc.
                     Can also be enabled via MISE_LOCKED=1 or
                     settings.locked=true
      --silent       Suppress all task output and mise non-error messages
